goalTranslation.businessGoal: Teams publish validated, human-approved decks instead of hand-polishing unreviewable AI drafts; north-star is validated, human-approved decks published per active team (docs/PRD.md).
decomposition: intake prompt into a deck outline
generate slides as scoped, schema-validated patch operations
validate and deterministically repair renders (bounded loop, labeled termination)
suspend for human acceptance of every agent mutation
publish only behind the fail-closed approval gate

tiers.action: Author a scoped, validated, receipted deck-patch proposal (no deck mutation)
Apply an agent-proposed patch to the deck
Publish a deck version to the public snapshot

interception.how: convex/lib/nodeslideErrorRedaction.ts scrubs capability-shaped secrets before any error text is persisted or returned; convex/lib/nodeslideBudgetedProvider.ts converts every provider failure into a coded { ok: false, code, reason } result instead of a bare throw.

fallback.description: Provider JSON gets exactly one repair attempt (two model calls max) before falling back deterministically; artifact rendering degrades to the static-fallback editability tier (shared/nodeslideArtifactAtlas.ts) instead of erroring.

context.noneRationale: No conversation-context compression exists. Each provider call is a bounded single-shot structured request; the per-run budget (shared/nodeslideRunBudget.ts) caps input tokens, output tokens, cost, duration, iterations, and tool calls instead of accumulating a transcript.

slos.rationale: docs/PRD.md: every render-repair run terminates with a clean result or a labeled stop, never unbounded.
docs/PRD.md: 100% of agent mutations gated until human acceptance.

costFuse.onTrip: Reserve-before-dispatch (convex/lib/nodeslideBudgetedProvider.ts): a call whose worst case does not fit the remaining budget is refused with a coded result before the provider is reached; default budget also caps spend at 1 USD per run (shared/nodeslideRunBudget.ts).

orchestration.dispatcher: Coordination pass in convex/lib/nodeslideMultiAgent.ts briefs a fixed set of cognitive roles; roles never spawn further agents (depth is 1 by construction).
